component.name: Materialize
component.summary: Generate PBR materials from a single image

description.p: Materialize is a tool for creating standard PBR materials for use in games from images. You can create an entire material from a single diffuse/albedo image or import the textures you have and generate the missing maps.

This is a Unity 6 port of the original Bounding Box Software project, featuring native Linux compatibility. Unlike previous iterations, this version retains full FreeImage support with specific fixes to handle .tif/.tiff metadata, preventing Segmentation Faults during heavy processing.
